design_philosophy: A premium, human-designed, strategic negotiation AI product. Avoids all generic AI clichés (no purple, no blobs, no neon, no chatgpt aesthetics). Feels like a high-end productivity and executive training platform. Utilizes an editorial layout, deep contrast, and a single distinctive accent color to communicate precision, intelligence, and controlled tension.

headings.usage: Used for main marketing headings, large editorial numbers in dashboards, and scenario titles. Conveys a premium, human, and authoritative tone.

body.usage: Used for all UI elements, chat messages, data tables, and general body copy. Clean, highly legible, modern.

rules: H1 must use tracking-tight and leading-none.
Use Playfair Display for all large data numbers (e.g., score '85', deal health '92%').
Labels/Overlines must be uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-xs, using Manrope.

accent.description: Terracotta/Rust. Represents momentum, tension, and primary actions. It is earthy yet urgent, completely avoiding generic AI blue/purple.

textures: Subtle grain/noise overlay on the background (opacity 2-3%).
Barely visible grid pattern in the hero section and dashboard background (1px lines, 5% opacity white).
lighting: Subtle radial lighting (soft white or very faint terracotta) to draw focus, NEVER bright neon.
borders: Cards do not have heavy shadows; they rely on 1px borders and slight background lightness differences.
radii: Very minimal border radii. Use `rounded-sm` (4px) or `rounded-none` for a sharp, precise, confident, enterprise look.
glassmorphism: Used selectively ONLY for the floating navigation and sticky action bars. Must use backdrop-blur-xl with a 1px border-white/10 and bg-black/60.

layouts.marketing_page: Scroll-based storytelling. High-contrast typography. Use the bento grid for feature highlights. Generous whitespace (py-24 to py-32).
layouts.dashboard: Bento Grid protocol. High density but perfectly aligned. Use cardless sections where possible, relying on 1px borders (border-collapse style) to separate metrics.
layouts.negotiation_room: Split screen layout. Left/Right sidebars (Opponent profile, Stance, Momentum, Pressure Meter) and a central wide column for the chat scenario. Feels like a command center, not a messaging app.
layouts.spacing: Tailwind scale. Use padding generously (p-8, p-12) in empty states, tight gaps (gap-4) in data dense panels.

components.navigation: Floating SaaS nav. Centered pill shape, backdrop-blur, containing logo, minimal links, and a sharp Terracotta CTA button.
components.buttons: Sharp edges (`rounded-sm`). Primary button: bg-[#C84B31] text-white hover:bg-[#A83F28]. Secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#272A30] hover:bg-[#1E2128].
components.scenario_cards: Hover-reactive. Monochromatic default state. On hover: a 1px Terracotta line expands, and the card elevates slightly (-translate-y-1). Shows difficulty, role, and duration as minimal tags.
components.chat_interface: No traditional 'bubbles'. Editorial layout where AI opponent text is left-aligned with a subtle vertical line, and user text is indented. Elegant typing indicator (fade-in text, not jumping dots).
components.meters_and_charts: Pressure meter: A clean horizontal or semi-circle line gauge using Recharts or simple div widths. Minimalist axes. Concession tracker: Step-based timeline component.
components.inputs: Premium input field: 1px border-[#272A30], bg-[#0D0E11], focus:border-[#C84B31] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#C84B31].

motion.transitions: Use `transition-all duration-300 ease-out` for hovers. No bouncy animations.
motion.entrances: Staggered fade-up for dashboard widgets and chat messages (`framer-motion` with `y: 10, opacity: 0` to `y: 0, opacity: 1`).
motion.micro_interactions: Cursor/light details used tastefully (e.g., a subtle highlight following the cursor on scenario cards).

hero_background_texture.description: Dark abstract background with subtle warm light. Use as a very low opacity background layer.

opponent_avatars.description: Executive portrait, use for AI opponent 'The CEO'.
Executive portrait, use for AI opponent 'The Procurement Officer'.

scenario_covers.description: Minimalist architecture, use for Enterprise Contract scenario.
Abstract structural lines, use for Salary Negotiation scenario.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG AA standards against the deep charcoal background.
accessibility.focus: Focus states must use the Terracotta accent color for high visibility.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Install Playfair Display and Manrope from Google Fonts. Install framer-motion, recharts, and lucide-react.
instructions_to_main_agent.execution_order: 1. Layout wrapper with noise texture. 2. Landing page. 3. Dashboard layout. 4. Scenario Selection. 5. Negotiation Chat Room (most complex). 6. Coaching Report.
rules: DO NOT use generic AI emojis or gradients.
DO NOT use Inter or standard sans-serif for headings.
Build the Negotiation Room as a professional command center, not a consumer chat app.
Use data-testid on all interactive elements.
Adhere strictly to the color palette and minimal border radii.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and 1px borders instead of heavy drop shadows.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Phosphor or Lucide icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
